events.title: NVIDIA opens Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开放 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 与 Granary v2
events.summary: NVIDIA released open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe for multilingual transcription, speaker attribution, translation and audio question answering. The 30B mixture-of-experts model activates about 4B parameters, handles recordings up to one hour and supports task-dependent language sets. Granary v2 publishes a reusable curation pipeline and manifests spanning 463,062 hours, while source audio remains under each corpus's original license.
events.summary_en: NVIDIA released open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe for multilingual transcription, speaker attribution, translation and audio question answering. The 30B mixture-of-experts model activates about 4B parameters, handles recordings up to one hour and supports task-dependent language sets. Granary v2 publishes a reusable curation pipeline and manifests spanning 463,062 hours, while source audio remains under each corpus's original license.
events.summary_zh: NVIDIA 发布开放权重 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe，可做多语种转写、说话人归属、翻译和音频问答。这个 30B MoE 模型每次约激活 4B 参数，可处理最长一小时录音，不同任务支持的语言集合并不相同。Granary v2 公开可复用数据清洗流水线和覆盖 463,062 小时的 manifest；源音频仍受各语料原许可证约束。
events.why_it_matters: For speech and meeting-intelligence teams, one checkpoint now covers several pipeline stages with public weights and adaptation recipes. Vendor and leaderboard results still need workload-specific validation, especially names, speaker changes, long recordings and license lineage.
events.why_it_matters_en: For speech and meeting-intelligence teams, one checkpoint now covers several pipeline stages with public weights and adaptation recipes. Vendor and leaderboard results still need workload-specific validation, especially names, speaker changes, long recordings and license lineage.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对语音和会议智能团队来说，一个公开权重 checkpoint 现在可以覆盖多段流水线，并提供适配配方。厂商与榜单结果仍需按真实任务复核，尤其是专有名词、说话人切换、长录音和许可证链。

technical_details.tasks: transcription, speaker attribution, translation, timestamps and English-trained audio question answering
technical_details.language_scope: 40 transcription languages; 31 translation languages to/from English; 13 diarization languages
technical_details.audio_limit: recordings up to one hour; up to eight speakers
technical_details.dataset: Granary v2 manifests cover 463,062 hours, 48 languages and 16 source corpora
technical_details.license_limit: download source audio separately under each corpus's original license
technical_details.evidence_limit: headline model results are NVIDIA-reported; public leaderboards cover selected tasks and conditions
technical_details.time_basis: Hugging Face RSS published 2026-10-28T14:58:17Z; model card modified 2026-10-28T13:44:41Z

technical_details_zh.任务: 转写、说话人归属、翻译、时间戳和以英语训练的音频问答
technical_details_zh.语言范围: 转写 40 种语言；31 种语言与英语互译；说话人归属 13 种语言
technical_details_zh.音频限制: 最长一小时录音；最多八名说话人
technical_details_zh.数据集: Granary v2 manifest 覆盖 463,062 小时、48 种语言和 16 个源语料
technical_details_zh.许可限制: 源音频需按各语料原许可证另行下载
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 主要模型结果由 NVIDIA 报告；公开榜单只覆盖选定任务与条件
technical_details_zh.时间依据: Hugging Face RSS 发布于 2026-10-28T14:58:17Z；模型卡修改于 2026-10-28T13:44:41Z

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用真实多说话人录音测 WER、说话人切换、每小时延迟和显存，并核对语料许可。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, test WER, speaker changes, per-hour latency and memory on a real multi-speaker recording, and review corpus licenses.

evidence.claim_zh: NVIDIA/Hugging Face 文章、模型卡和数据集页共同确认权重、任务范围、语言范围、数据规模、许可证与证据限制。
evidence.claim_en: The NVIDIA/Hugging Face article, model card and dataset page jointly confirm weights, task and language scope, data scale, licenses and evidence limits.

changes.summary_zh: NVIDIA 开放多语种 Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 与 Granary v2。
changes.summary_en: NVIDIA opens multilingual Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2.

events.title: Google restricts Gemini 4 Carbon to selected cyber defenders
events.title_zh: Google 将 Gemini 4 Carbon 限于部分网络防御者
events.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon as a cybersecurity-focused frontier model, but access is limited to a subset of defenders and will expand through a phased trusted-partner program. It is not available to general developers, businesses or consumers. Google reports gains on several cyber benchmarks and announced introductory API pricing for a later launch; those results are vendor-run and the public launch date is not fixed.
events.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 4 Carbon as a cybersecurity-focused frontier model, but access is limited to a subset of defenders and will expand through a phased trusted-partner program. It is not available to general developers, businesses or consumers. Google reports gains on several cyber benchmarks and announced introductory API pricing for a later launch; those results are vendor-run and the public launch date is not fixed.
events.summary_zh: Google 发布面向网络安全的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，但当前只向部分防御者开放，并将通过可信合作伙伴计划分阶段扩大。普通开发者、企业和消费者目前不能使用。Google 公布多项自测成绩和未来上线时的首发 API 价格；这些结果来自厂商，公开上线时间尚未确定。
events.why_it_matters: For security teams, Carbon signals stronger long-horizon cyber automation, but restricted access prevents reproducible evaluation and general integration. Treat price and benchmark claims as planning inputs, not deployed capability.
events.why_it_matters_en: For security teams, Carbon signals stronger long-horizon cyber automation, but restricted access prevents reproducible evaluation and general integration. Treat price and benchmark claims as planning inputs, not deployed capability.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对安全团队来说，Carbon 显示长流程网络任务的自动化能力继续增强，但受限访问使外部团队无法复现或集成。价格与 benchmark 只能作为规划线索，不能当作已部署能力。

technical_details.availability: pre-release; selected cyber defenders only; phased access through the Fairwind trusted-partner program
technical_details.general_access: not available to developers, businesses or consumers
technical_details.vendor_benchmarks: AA Index 59; SEC-bench Pro 88.2%; ExploitGym 54.8%; CWE-bench 71%
technical_details.announced_launch_price: $2/M input tokens and $10/M output tokens; cached input 95% off; eventual price announced as $4/$20
technical_details.evidence_limit: benchmarks and safety evaluations are Google-reported; no public API or weights
technical_details.independent_evaluation: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5: 59 (#1); Coding Agent Index: second to Claude Opus 5.5; evaluation article is date-only and model access remains restricted

technical_details_zh.开放阶段: 预发布；仅部分网络防御者；通过 Fairwind 可信合作伙伴计划分阶段扩大
technical_details_zh.普遍可用性: 开发者、企业与消费者目前不能使用
technical_details_zh.已公布首发价格: 输入 $2/M token、输出 $10/M token；缓存输入优惠 95%；后续价格计划为 $4/$20
technical_details_zh.证据限制: benchmark 与安全评估由 Google 自报；没有公开 API 或权重
technical_details_zh.独立评测: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5：59（第 1）；Coding Agent Index：仅次于 Claude Opus 5.5；评测文章只提供日期，模型访问仍受限

events.next_action_zh: 等待公开 API、明确地区与资格，并出现独立网络安全评测后再安排集成验证。
events.next_action_en: Reassess after a public API, clear regional eligibility and independent cybersecurity evaluation are available.

evidence.claim_zh: Google 公告确认 Carbon 的受限预发布、访问对象、厂商 benchmark 与未来定价；未提供公开 API 或权重。
evidence.claim_en: Google confirms Carbon’s restricted pre-release, access cohort, vendor benchmarks and future pricing; no public API or weights are available.

evidence.claim_zh: Artificial Analysis 独立报告 Carbon 在 Intelligence Index v5 得 59 分并列第 1，在 Coding Agent Index 位居第二；评测不改变模型仍受限预发布的事实。
evidence.claim_en: Artificial Analysis independently reports Carbon at 59 and first on Intelligence Index v5, and second on its Coding Agent Index; this does not change the restricted pre-release access.

changes.summary_zh: Google 向部分网络防御者预发布 Gemini 4 Carbon。
changes.summary_en: Google pre-releases Gemini 4 Carbon to selected cyber defenders.

events.title: GitHub makes connected Copilot cloud sessions generally available
events.title_zh: GitHub 正式开放可跨端续接的 Copilot 云会话
events.summary: GitHub made its connected Copilot cloud experience generally available on paid Copilot plans, with rollout starting October 28. A session can move across web, mobile, CLI, VS Code, Slack and Teams while running in resumable GitHub-managed sandboxes. Cloud sandbox billing starts in November 2026 and draws from a shared dollar-based Actions compute entitlement.
events.summary_en: GitHub made its connected Copilot cloud experience generally available on paid Copilot plans, with rollout starting October 28. A session can move across web, mobile, CLI, VS Code, Slack and Teams while running in resumable GitHub-managed sandboxes. Cloud sandbox billing starts in November 2026 and draws from a shared dollar-based Actions compute entitlement.
events.summary_zh: GitHub 将跨端续接的 Copilot 云体验向付费方案正式开放，并从 10 月 28 日开始滚动上线。同一会话可在网页、移动端、CLI、VS Code、Slack 与 Teams 之间继续，并运行在可恢复的 GitHub 托管 sandbox 中。云 sandbox 从 2026 年 11 月开始计费，并与 Actions 共用按金额计算的算力额度。
events.why_it_matters: For coding-agent teams, session portability and resumable sandboxes change where state, credentials and compute budgets live. Enterprise permission policies and MCP allowlists carry over, but isolation, snapshot retention and real billing still need tenant-specific testing.
events.why_it_matters_en: For coding-agent teams, session portability and resumable sandboxes change where state, credentials and compute budgets live. Enterprise permission policies and MCP allowlists carry over, but isolation, snapshot retention and real billing still need tenant-specific testing.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 coding agent 团队来说，跨端会话与可恢复 sandbox 改变了状态、凭据和算力预算的归属。企业权限与 MCP allowlist 会继承，但隔离、快照保留和实际费用仍需按租户验证。

technical_details.availability: generally available on paid Copilot plans; rolling out from 2026-10-28
technical_details.surfaces: web, mobile, app, CLI, VS Code, Slack and Microsoft Teams
technical_details.sandbox: GitHub-managed isolated environment; snapshots support cross-surface resume; no one-hour total session cap
technical_details.billing: cloud sandbox billing starts November 2026; shared dollar-based Actions entitlement; overage follows existing settings
technical_details.governance: enterprise-managed agent permissions and MCP server allowlists apply
technical_details.time_basis: GitHub changelog exposes date 2026-10-28 without time; recovered by targeted late-discovery review

technical_details_zh.开放阶段: 付费 Copilot 方案 GA；从 2026-10-28 开始滚动上线
technical_details_zh.覆盖入口: 网页、移动端、App、CLI、VS Code、Slack 与 Microsoft Teams
technical_details_zh.sandbox: GitHub 托管隔离环境；快照支持跨端续接；没有一小时总会话上限
technical_details_zh.计费: 云 sandbox 从 2026 年 11 月开始计费；与 Actions 共用按金额计算的额度；超额沿用现有设置
technical_details_zh.治理: 企业托管的 agent 权限与 MCP server allowlist 会继承
technical_details_zh.时间依据: GitHub changelog 只提供 2026-10-28 日期；本轮通过定向补漏发现

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用测试仓库跨 CLI 与网页续接会话，核对快照隔离、MCP allowlist、凭据与额度扣费。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, resume a test session across CLI and web; verify snapshot isolation, MCP allowlists, credentials and entitlement charges.

evidence.claim_zh: GitHub changelog确认付费方案 GA、跨端会话、云 sandbox、11 月计费和 Actions 共享额度。
evidence.claim_en: GitHub’s changelog confirms paid-plan GA, cross-surface sessions, cloud sandboxes, November billing and the shared Actions entitlement.

changes.summary_zh: GitHub 将跨端 Copilot 云会话与可恢复 sandbox 推入 GA。
changes.summary_en: GitHub moves cross-surface Copilot cloud sessions and resumable sandboxes to GA.
